preconditions.description: Both input strings P and T are non-empty.
The lengths of P and T do not exceed 10^4.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum(1 for subset in non_empty_subsets(positions) if is_good_number(product(subset))) % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of non-empty subsets of starting positions of P in T such that the product of positions in the subset is divisible by all integers from 1 to 9, modulo 10^9+7.
